augmentations.coordinate_semantics: Coherent XY symmetries preserve every distance/angle scalar feature; never exchange Z with XY or reverse time.
augmentations.spatial_semantics: All tokens share one physical sampling shift and support-scale change; world node coordinates and their relative geometry stay fixed. This perturbs image sampling, not graph identity.

deviation: Budget selected from measured source end-to-end throughput; matched arms retain equal optimizer updates.
precision: FP32; TF32 disabled; activation checkpoint chunks of 16 tokens
repair: Complete-decision labels did not penalize removed supported GT edges; augmentation recipe omitted specified blur and crop-sampling perturbations.
source_checkpoint: fixed final checkpoint; no target selection
